markdown:
*Vehicle, civilian*

A street scooter—or a motor scooter, or just a scooter—is a motorcycle with an underbone or step-through frame, a seat, and a platform for the rider's feet, emphasizing comfort and fuel economy. Elements of scooter design were present in some of the earliest motorcycles, and motor scooters have been made since at least 1914 OW.

Nowadays, street scooters are fast and are the vehicle of choice for many people in the southside of Neon City, offering a light and affordable method of transportation for those who are not content to only rely on Autobae and public transportation. The most popular model in circulation is the KAI TKS-250 from [Kazanari Automotive](/corp:kazanari-automotive), though several older models (like the HTS-225, considered one of the most reliable machines, or the MKS-175, which is prized for its incredible suspension system and comfortable ride) are still very popular, particularly in the secondary market.

*Street Scooter · *Medium vehicle (bike) (250 lb)* · **Creature Capacity** 1 Medium creature · **Cargo Capacity** 100 lbs. · **Armor Class** 19 (16 when stationary) · **Hit Points** 40 (damage threshold 10, mishap threshold 15) · **Speed** 150 ft. · STR — DEX — CON — INT — WIS — CHA · 13 (+1) — 16 (+3) — 14 (+2) — 0 (—) — 0 (—) — 0 (—) · **Saving Throws** (—) · **Damage Immunities** poison, software · **Condition Immunities** blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious · **Proficiency Bonus** +2 · ***Jump.*** If a street scooter moves at least 30 feet in a straight line, it can clear a distance of up to 60 feet when jumping over a chasm, ravine, or other gap. Each foot it clears on the jump costs a foot of movement. · ***Prone Deficiency.*** If a vehicle rolls over and falls prone, it can’t right itself and is incapacitated until flipped upright. · ***City Driver.*** A street scooter requires a paved road to be fully effective. A street scooter moves at half speed when being driven in terrain that is not a paved road (either bricks, smooth paved roads, etc.). · Action Stations · ***Driver (Requires 1 Crew).*** Drive and steer the vehicle.*
